author: Jordan Honeycutt
title: Albuquerque man accused of shooting and killing his girlfriend - NewsBreak
text:
By Jordan Honeycutt No media credit provided. ,
3 hours ago
ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – An Albuquerque man is facing charges after police say he shot his girlfriend over the weekend. Police said that 33-year-old James Candelaria told them that he and Destiny Benavidez were drinking at home on Edith near Gibson when she got upset over another woman. Candelaria claimed he blacked out but woke up holding Benavidez, and she was bleeding from her head.
Former Albuquerque Police officer sentenced for deadly off-duty motorcycle crash She died on Wednesday. Candelaria is charged with murder. The state is fighting to keep him locked up until trial.
